expected.title: Apple iPhone 17 512 GB: 15.93 cm (6.3″) Display with Promotion, A19 Chip, Center Stage Front Camera for Smarter Group Selfies, Improved Scratch Resistance, All-Day Battery Life; White

highlights.heading: DESIGNED TO DELIGHT. BUILT TO LAST
highlights.text: iPhone 17 comes in five gorgeous colours, with a brighter 15.93 cm (6.3″) display and a Ceramic Shield 2 front that’s 3x more scratch resistant.

highlights.heading: SMOOTHER. BRIGHTER. BRILLIANT
highlights.text: Smooth scrolling with ProMotion up to 120Hz, better outdoor contrast with 3,000 nits peak brightness and 33% fewer reflections compared with previous generation.

highlights.heading: 18MP CENTER STAGE FRONT CAMERA
highlights.text: Flexible ways to frame your shot. Smarter group selfies, Dual Capture video for simultaneous front and rear recording, and more.

highlights.heading: STUNNING SHOTS
highlights.text: Capture super-high-resolution shots by default with the 48MP Dual Fusion camera system, 4x optical zoom range and 48MP Fusion Ultra Wide camera.

highlights.heading: A19 CHIP. POWER PLAYER. ENERGY EXPERT
highlights.text: With a 5-core GPU, the enhanced neural engine helps power everything you do on iPhone — from Apple Intelligence to AAA games.

highlights.heading: CHARGES FAST. MAKES IT LAST
highlights.text: All-day battery life with up to 30 hours of video playback. Charge up to 50% in 20 minutes.

highlights.heading: iOS
highlights.text: A fresh design with Liquid Glass. Beautiful, delightful and instantly familiar. With a more vibrant Lock Screen, customisable backgrounds and polls in Messages, Call Screening and more.

highlights.heading: BUILT FOR APPLE INTELLIGENCE
highlights.text: Personal, private, powerful. Write, express yourself and get things done effortlessly.

highlights.heading: VITAL SAFETY FEATURES
highlights.text: With Crash Detection, iPhone can detect a severe car crash and call for help if you can’t.

highlights.heading: STRONGER CONNECTIVITY. SUPERFAST SPEEDS
highlights.text: Stay connected at faster speeds with secure connections to Wi-Fi 7, 5G networks and Bluetooth 6, plus eSIM.

specs.label: Display
specs.value: Super Retina XDR display 15.93 cm / 6.3in (diagonal) all‑screen OLED display 2622x1206-pixel resolution at 460 ppi

specs.label: Splash, Water, and Dust Resistant
specs.value: Rated IP68 (maximum depth of 6 metres up to 30 minutes) under IEC standard 60529

specs.label: Camera & Video
specs.value: 48MP Fusion Main: 26 mm, ƒ/1.6 aperture, sensor-shift optical image stabilisation, 100% Focus Pixels, support for super-high-resolution photos (24MP and 48MP) Also enables 12MP optical-quality 2x Telephoto: 52 mm, ƒ/1.6 aperture, sensor-shift optical image stabilisation, 100% Focus Pixels 48MP Fusion Ultra Wide: 13 mm, ƒ/2.2 aperture and 120° field of view, Hybrid Focus Pixels, support for super-high-resolution photos (24MP and 48MP) 2x optical zoom in, 2x optical zoom out; 4x optical zoom range Digital zoom up to 10x

specs.label: Front Camera
specs.value: 18MP Center Stage camera ƒ/1.9 aperture Autofocus with Focus Pixels Retina Flash Tap to zoom and rotate Centre Stage for photos
